title: An indented comment after the only item of a root sequence goes with it when it is removed
notes: The comment line is indented more than the item's dash, so it belongs to the item (docs/edit-semantics.md, Comments) and goes with it; the emptied root sequence is written `[]`. `edit/remove-only-item-of-a-nested-sequence-keeps-the-footer-comment` is the other side: there the comment is indented as the item, not more, and stays. The exact bytes rest on a kit convention.

provenance.reference: Differential testing of the oneyaml-python native and pure backends; the pure backend removed the comment with the item; the native backend left `  # f` behind the `[]`.
